notes: WorldMemeToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. Its constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 WORLD with 18 decimals to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no privileged functions, transfer fees or post-deployment minting. No application contracts are included. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
